notes: «- وهذا لفظه وهو أتم -» is an editor's gloss, left out
«قالا حدثنا ابن نمير» (dual): both branches meet, so the names after it are the shared tail (rule 3)

«رواه محمد بن سلمة وسعدان بن يحيى عن ابن إسحاق بإسناده» names other transmitters for the same saying; it is not written as a route here because its «بإسناده» would not fit the shared tail. Left for review
